episodes.title: Persons of Interest
episodes.summary: An international manhunt ignites when the son of U.S. media mogul Katherine Newman is violently kidnapped.

episodes.title: Room for Doubt
episodes.summary: Vanessa and Scott work together to interrogate the suspects. A mysterious figure leaves a path of destruction in his wake.

episodes.title: Strangers
episodes.summary: The suspects return home and attempt to patch their lives back together. A surprising connection is revealed.

episodes.title: The Devil You Know
episodes.summary: Eddie teams up with Aadesh to clear their names. Natalie helps Vanessa and Scott in their quest. Katherine faces pressure to tell the truth.

episodes.title: What Does a Kidnapper Look Like?
episodes.summary: Hiding in a country cottage, the five suspects attempt to uncover who framed them—or who among them is guilty.

episodes.title: Be the Gray Man
episodes.summary: The suspects prepare to flee, but each must decide which way to run. Vanessa shares a secret with Scott. Katherine does client damage control.

episodes.title: Questions of Trust
episodes.summary: Vanessa and Scott investigate Martin Copeland as the suspects try to hunt him down. Katherine risks everything in a shocking interview.

episodes.title: Unmasked
episodes.summary: Season finale. As Leo's countdown begins, Cresswell's past leads Vanessa and Scott to uncover the truth.
